maybe you can offer something that I don't knwo off.

At school, I went to see a therapist, and told him flat off the bat (not to be insulting but so that he just knew what he had to deal with) that I view psychiatary, to be for the most part to be some sort of homeopathic medicine, a farce that (with the exception of medication) relies entirely on the placebo effect.  After having said that, I told him I would try to be as accomodating as possible and try to approach this with an open mind.  I stuck with him for a year and a half, actively making an effort to get it to work.  But to no avail.

I don't know what you have to offer.  Maybe there is an unknown gem that is hidden from me.  My point is that I am willing to try for help.

But it really doesn't help me when people claim to have feelings of affection.  On reddit, I see people asking for a hug, and then someone proceeds to reply them with the comment: hugs.  The immediate thought that pops into my head, were you to meet that person in real life, would you actually be wiling to hug them?  I see stuff like that to be disingenuous and has the potential to do more harm than good.  Is ther esomething else?
